Common copy-number pieces of the clones of a tumour run (MEDICC2 export, step 1)

Source: R/medicc2.R
medicc2_pieces.Rd

Drops doublet clones, clones with fewer than min_assigned assigned cells and clones without segments; builds the union of the remaining clones' segment breakpoints (segment_pieces()) on chroms, maps every clone's state to every piece (segment containing the piece midpoint, as piece_states()) and keeps the pieces covered by every kept clone (gaps of any clone, e.g. missing windows or a clone-specific chromosome start, are dropped). Pieces shorter than min_len are then absorbed into an adjacent piece of the same chromosome (gap <= max_gap): the neighbour whose states differ in the fewest clones, the longer one on ties; the neighbour keeps its states and extends over the short piece. A short piece without an eligible neighbour is dropped. Adjacent pieces with identical states are not merged here: merging needs the common haplotype orientation and is done by medicc2_table().

Usage

medicc2_pieces(
  segments,
  clones = NULL,
  min_len = 1e+06,
  max_gap = Inf,
  min_assigned = 1,
  chroms = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X")),
  normal = "N0"
)

Arguments

segments

segments table (clone, chrom, start, end, state, cn, label, ploidy; nA, nB, f optional)

clones

clones table (clone, doublet, n_assigned); NULL keeps every clone of segments

min_len

pieces shorter than this (bp) are absorbed into a neighbour

max_gap

maximal gap (bp) between a short piece and the neighbour it is absorbed into

min_assigned

clones with fewer assigned cells are dropped (the normal clone normal is always kept)

chroms

chromosomes exported (MEDICC2: chr1-22 and chrX)

normal

name of the normal clone

Value

long data.table, one row per clone x piece: piece (seg|all|chrom:start-end), chrom, start, end, clone, state, major, minor, cn, label, ploidy, imbalanced (major != minor on a diploid piece; these need orientation), seg_nA, seg_nB, seg_f (the containing segment's pooled votes in the clone's own orientation, NA when absent). Attributes clones_dropped (clone, reason) and pieces_dropped (chrom, start, end, reason: not_all_clones / short_isolated) and n_pieces_raw (pieces before the coverage filter).
